snapshot.title: User-only actions: ready, status, move, rm, deps
snapshot.description:
The user-only actions that currently need `buf curl`.

- `underdraw ready <feature-id>`: promote a draft (UpdateItem, mask `feature.draft`).
- `underdraw status <id> <status>`: set a task's status (including `done`) or a feature's override; `--clear` removes the override.
- `underdraw move <id> --before <id> | --after <id>`: rerank.
- `underdraw rm <id>`: delete.
- `underdraw dep add <id> <blocker> [--until review]` and `underdraw dep rm <id> <blocker>`.
- `underdraw release <task-id>`: free a stuck claim.

Each command fetches the current revision itself.
